commercial_status: Original non-commissioned motion-design demonstration, not a real client case or claimed event production
title: MAKE / IT MOVE.
method: True offline-rendered 3D typography authored in Blender: converted text outlines from the declared system font, physical bevels, PBR materials, procedural resin, softbox lighting, perspective camera and periodic absolute animation. Not image-to-video, stock footage or a live interactive model.
source_colour: AgX, Medium High Contrast, SDR PNG8 masters; H.264 BT.709 primaries/matrix with sRGB transfer as probed
loop: Analytic periodic camera/body/light poses; master frame121 equals frame1 to below 1e-16. Video contains frames1..120, so the next-loop frame1 is the next chronological phase, not a repeated hold or reversed sequence.
font: System Arial Bold converted to outlines for rendered typography; no font file distributed with public media.

memory_guard.estimate: Mach vm_stat free+inactive+speculative pages before every frame; not a measured GPU-memory counter
memory_guard.stops: Outputs retained and next frame cancelled if the threshold is crossed

render.source: Original authored 3D text geometry, materials, lighting, animation and camera
render.font: System Arial Bold rendered as glyph outlines; no font file distributed
render.loop: 120 periodic poses; pose121 equals pose1; chronological forward motion, no interpolation, no reverse

render.source: Original authored 3D text geometry, materials, lighting, animation and camera
render.font: System Arial Bold rendered as glyph outlines; no font file distributed
render.loop: 120 periodic poses; pose121 equals pose1; chronological forward motion, no interpolation, no reverse
